thread:
sara_aes: FYI — FinCloud's SIG flagged a hard requirement for FIPS HSM / BYOK for their POC. They're asking for signoff or compensating controls today. Link to questionnaire: https://redwood.share/fincloud-sig :eyes:

mike_sec: Timeline? FIPS HSM isn't available on hosted. Two paths: Dedicated/Private or compensating controls. I can draft controls but need business ok for temporary gap.

arun_prd: POC needs to start next week. If Dedicated takes >5 business days we'll lose momentum. Any short-term mitigations we can stand up on hosted to get them started?

elena_legal: From legal side we can do a limited SOW amendment + contractual attestation for the POC window, but we need sec to document technical mitigations and risk acceptance language.

mike_sec: Drafted summary of compensating controls we can propose to FinCloud (POC-only, 30 days):
```
- Dedicated VPC + private endpoints (no public egress)
- Envelope encryption: customer-managed KMS keys; server-side envelope keys with strict key usage policy (no key export)
- Access controls: least-privilege IAM roles + mandatory MFA for ops
- Logging: all access & model outputs forwarded to customer's SIEM in near-real time
- Data retention: plaintext artifacts deleted within 72 hours; persistent KV cache disabled for customer sessions
- Operational attestation: weekly snapshot exported and signed by Redwood sec
```
These mitigate most threats from the lack of certified HSM for short-term POC. Need confirmation from infra on feasibility for hosted.

sara_aes: Can we get the "delete plaintext <72h" enforcement as a config flag for the POC tenant? Customer will escalate otherwise.

mike_sec: Yes — we can add a tenant-level retention policy and disable persistent KV caching. Will need a quick infra change but doable in 48 hours if infra prioritizes.

arun_prd: If infra can do 48h work, we can kick POC on hosted under these compensations and convert to Dedicated if they commit. That keeps sales funnel warm.

elena_legal: I'll prepare the SOW amendment template and risk acceptance language. Need sec to provide a one-paragraph executive statement tying controls to residual risk.

mike_sec: Executive statement (draft): "Redwood acknowledges FinCloud's requirement for FIPS-certified HSM. For the duration of the POC Redwood will implement the compensating controls listed and accepts residual risk for this limited engagement. Controls include envelope encryption with customer-managed keys, network isolation, enhanced logging to the customer's SIEM, and contractual limitations on data retention. This conditional acceptance is valid only for the POC window and will be revisited prior to production enrollment."

elena_legal: Good. I'll put that language into the amendment and the questionnaire response. Also adding an escalation clause if any suspected exfiltration occurs.

risk-bot: ACTION: risk-conditional-signoff created by mike_sec. ID: RSK-2026-3987. Status: pending CISO review.

tom_ciso: Quick read — I'm comfortable with a conditional, timeboxed acceptance for POC only. Requirements before sign-off:
- Quarterly pentest evidence or SOC2 report in last 12 months
- Read-only export of logs to customer's SIEM + alerting on suspicious activity
- Explicit contractual clause limiting POC data retention to 72 hours and prohibiting model training on PII
If those are in place, Tom (CISO) signs off.

mike_sec: Confirmed. We'll attach SOC2 & pentest cadence, show SIEM pipeline, and include the non-training clause. I'll update the risk ticket.

sara_aes: Thanks team — I'll tell FinCloud we have a path forward: POC on hosted with compensating controls + SOW amendment, conditional on CISO sign-off. Will push for Dedicated if they want long-term BYOK/FIPS.

elena_legal: I'll circulate the SOW amendment and questionnaire update after sec ticket is updated. Target: send to customer EOD tomorrow.

tom_ciso: Marking conditional approval in my queue; will sign after I see the SOC2 snapshot and the retention configuration in staging.

sara_aes: Great — will ping again once infra confirms retention flag. :thumbsup:
